desc.cardBoard3D: DRESSES DA CARD GAME IN DA REAL 3D CREATURES INSTEAD OF DEY WALKIN' SPRITES: MODELS ON DA 3X3 BOARD, AN' DA CREATURE TURNIN' ON DA SPOT INSIDE ITS OWN CARD. EACH ONE IZ GROWN FROM DA SAME SEED AS DA CARD DAT PLAYED IT, SO TWO COPIES OF A MONSTER NEVER LOOK DA SAME. COSTS A WHOLE THREE.JS SCENE BEHIND DA MENU, AN' DA BUTTON IN DA DUEL'S FOOTER CHANGES IT AT DA TABLE!
desc.enemySpawnMode: DECIDES HOW STRONG DA ENEMIES WANDERIN' DA WORLD IZ. WHICHEVER YOU PICK, DA YEAR PUSHES EVERY LEVEL UP: +10 A YEAR TA 2010, DA WHOLE TABLE LOOSE TA LEVEL 110 IN 2010-2011, AN' NOTHIN' UNDER LEVEL 80 LEFT FROM 2012!
desc.weatherVolume: SCALES DA OUTDOOR AMBIENCE: RAIN, STORMS, WIND, DA NIGHT CHORUS AN' DA AMBIENT BED OF DA BIOME YOU IZ STANDIN' IN. IT RIDES ON TOP OF DA BGS VOLUME, AN' LEAVES INTERIORS AN' A MAP'S OWN AUTHORED SOUNDS ALONE!
desc.partyHud: A CARD FOR EVERY PARTY MEMBER IN DA TOP-LEFT CORNER OF DA MAP: DEY HP, MP, DA STATES ON DEM, AN' A CHIP FOR ANYTHIN' URGENT, LOW HEALTH, HUNGER, SLEEP, HYGIENE, COMPANY, FUN OR A CRAVIN'!
desc.partyFormation: HOW DA REST OF DA PARTY WALKS BEHIND DA LEADER ON DA MAP!
desc.musicArtistDisplay: WHETHER DA GAME TELLS YOU WHAT MUSIC IZ PLAYIN' AN' WHO MADE IT!

partyFormation: CLOSE: DA OLD MARCHIN' COLUMN. EVERYONE WALKS IN DA LEADER'S EXACT FOOTSTEPS, ONE TILE APART, AN' NEVER STOPS FOR ANYTHIN'!

LOOSE: DEY LIVE DEY OWN LIVES AROUND YOU, WANDERIN', LOOKIN' AT THINGS, WASHIN', EATIN', PLAYIN' AN' STRIKIN' UP CONVERSATIONS WIT DA LOCALS, AN' SOMETIMES SIMPLY WALKIN' ALONG WIT YOU. WALKIN' NEAR DEM LEAVES DEM TA IT; ONLY SOMEONE CARRIED OFF DA SCREEN COMES BACK, AN' DEY SWIM AFTER YOU IF DERE IZ WATER IN DA WAY. SPRINT FOR TWO SECONDS AN' DEY FORM DA COLUMN BEHIND YOU, UNTIL YOU STOP SPRINTIN'. DEY IZ GATHERED UP AGAIN AFTER A BATTLE, A TRANSFER OR A CHANGE OF MAP. FACE ONE AN' PRESS OK TA TALK TA DEM!
enemySpawnMode: BALANCED: ENEMIES MATCH YA PARTY. ROAMERS STAY AT OR BELOW YA LEVEL, AN' EACH WORLD TILE HIDES ONE BOSS WELL ABOVE IT!
CHAOS: NOTHIN' IZ HELD BACK. ANYTHIN' FROM LEVEL 1 TA 110 ROAMS ANYWHERE, AN' EVERY TIME YOU STEP ONTO A PROCEDURAL MAP ITS MONSTERS IZ DEALT AGAIN!
musicArtistDisplay: FIRST TIME: DA CASSETTE, BUT ONLY DA FIRST TIME YOU EVER HEAR A TRACK. ANYTHIN' IT HAB ALREADY INTRODUCED PLAYS UNANNOUNCED. CHANGIN' DIS SETTIN' WIPES DA LIST OF TRACKS IT REMEMBERS, SO DA WHOLE LIBRARY INTRODUCES ITSELF AGAIN!

EVERY TIME: A TAPE WIT DA TRACK HANDWRITTEN ON ITS LABEL WINDS ITSELF INTO DA CORNER OF DA SCREEN FOR A FEW SECONDS, WHENEVER DA MUSIC COMES ROUND AGAIN. NEVER IN A FIGHT, AN' NEVER TWICE FOR DA SAME TRACK INSIDE FIVE MINUTES!
MINIMAL: DA TRACK AN' ITS ARTIST APPEAR IN DA USUAL CORNER NOTIFICATION!
